newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to announce new economic policies Monday.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to announce new economic policies Monday.

text.p: Ecuador's government will announce a package of new economic policies on Monday, Finance Minister Carlos Davalos said Wednesday.

"When the meetings end, we will have some information. The worst thing the country can have is partial information, but probably on Monday we will be in a position to give information," Davalos said at a press conference.
Davalos added that in meetings between Finance Ministry officials and President Fabian Alarcon there have been no proposals to raise taxes on petrol and gas.

"There is nothing of this (petrol or gas tax hikes). When there is a new plan all will be announced, but it has to be known that the president is against such measures," he added. ((-- Maria Veronica Barreiros, Quito Newsroom, 5932 258433
